caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a large metal anchor or grappling hook with five curved prongs. The object is brown in color and appears to be made of metal, depicted with shading to give a three-dimensional effect. At the top, the anchor has a rounded loop, which transitions into a central shaft that further splits into five individual arms. Each arm curves outward and upward, ending in pointed tips. The background is a plain light beige or off-white, with no additional elements or objects present. The drawing is centered on the page, and the object appears to be suspended or floating, as there are no visible supports or ground lines. There is faint, small text in the lower right corner.
title: Grappling Hooks
